publisher: MIT Election Data and Science Lab
title: Each state legislative district's own 2024 general election votes, by party
universe: Regular general-election contests for the state house and state senate (special elections, primaries and runoffs left out); votes summed over the district's precincts and candidates, multi-member districts included
geography: State legislative districts of the states whose precinct returns the file carries, keyed by postal code, chamber and Census Gazetteer district code
limits: Elections held in 2024 only, so a chamber with no 2024 seat in a district (staggered senates) has no row for it. Rows are [Democratic votes, Republican votes, all other votes]. A district where only one major party ran is unopposed: its row is a count, not a two-party share, and the reader does not use it as one. 89303 precinct rows were redacted ('*') in the source and are left out. States absent from the file (for example Alabama, Arizona, Indiana, Louisiana, Maryland, Mississippi, New Jersey, Virginia and Washington) keep the state's vote at the typical margin. District names the file spells differently from the Census Gazetteer were not joined: MA|state-upper (24), MA|state-lower (1), NH|state-lower (39), NY|state-upper (1), NY|state-lower (1), RI|state-upper (1), RI|state-lower (1), VT|state-upper (1).
